hero.headline: IMPLEMENTATION CONSULTANT WITH UX AND SYSTEMS DEPTH
hero.description: I am an Implementation Consultant at Aptem, helping clients use learning and employability software. I bring experience in SaaS delivery, UX, eLearning, and teaching to client onboarding, reporting, and user support.
hero.framing: My current work includes Power Query and OData reporting, data validation, and technical handovers. I turn requirements into practical solutions and explain how they work.
